title.en: An Act Including the City of Angeles in the Coverage of the Jose Abad Santos Day, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act Numbered Seventy-Five Fifty-Two and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act Numbered Seventy-five fifty-two is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
May seven of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Pampanga and the City of Angeles to be known as the Jose Abad Santos Day."
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days from its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspapers of national circulation.
